text:
Maya: FYI EmberHealth QBR next Wed. Need a tight spend slide + onboarding status and any renewal flags.
Jon: On it. I'll pull 60d usage and a 3-week burn projection. Noticed a couple of daytime batch jobs hitting /embeddings.
Priya: Quick snapshot: current billing period tokens = 118.7M, avg daily = 3.9M, recent activation uplift ~32% last 10d.
Amir: If uplift continues they hit their soft threshold in ~10 days. Recommend temporary credits and a targeted throttle on the heavy embedding route.
FinOps-Bot: alert: EmberHealth retainer usage at 77% of committed for period ending 2026-03-15.
Maya: Renewal conversation: do we frame as minor ask or operational fix?
Priya: Mix. Product adoption looks good so renewal sentiment is positive. Finance will care about predictability.
Jon: Proposed QBR slide bullets: runway (tokens left + days), forecasted spike scenarios, recommended commercial ask (10% buffer or short-term top-up), enablement plan (prompt engineering + scheduling).
Maya: Suggested ask wording: "Recommend 10% retainer buffer next quarter to cover recent activation bursts; propose a 30-min enablement session for devs to reduce embed costs."
Amir: Added temporary 40k credits (expires 12d) to prevent immediate overages and left a note on the account. Also drafting a short SE checklist: 1) enable prefix caching, 2) batch off-peak, 3) review embed model params.
Priya: I'll write two customer feedback questions for the QBR: 1) "How important is latency vs cost for your embed use?" 2) "Would a short enablement session to reduce token usage be valuable?"
Jon: Can somebody pull per-route P95 latency + tokens for last 14d? I'll make the cost/latency tradeoff visual.
Maya: I can export P95 from Console and share CSV by EOD Thu.
Amir: Also recommend adding a policy in the account: auto-throttle above 85% retainer to avoid surprise overages. Want me to draft it?
Maya: Yes please. Add the policy draft to the deck appendix.
FinOps-Bot: note: invoices and previous commit history available at /billing/emberhealth/.
Jon: Action list: deck + visuals (me, due Fri EOD), P95 export (Maya), renewal blurb + feedback q's (Priya), credits & policy draft + SE checklist (Amir).
Priya: I'll post the two Qs here for quick edit later today.
Maya: Thanks team. Keeping this thread as canonical QBR ops thread for EmberHealth. Ping when you update your items. :white_check_mark:
